title: QA tester
short: Runs the project, goes through the main flows and edge cases, reports what broke with screenshots.
task: Test this project the way a careful person would and report what is broken.

title: Code reviewer
short: Reviews the current changes like a senior engineer: bugs, risks and missing tests, with file and line.
task: Review the current changes and report what could go wrong.

title: Security auditor
short: Looks for leaked secrets, injection, missing auth and vulnerable dependencies, each with a fix.
task: Audit this project for security problems.

title: Test writer
short: Finds important code with no tests and writes focused tests in the project's own framework.
task: Write tests for the most important code that has none, and run them.

title: Docs writer
short: Brings the README and docs in line with what the code really does.
task: Bring the README and docs in line with what the code does.

title: Dependency doctor
short: Checks outdated and vulnerable dependencies and proposes a safe upgrade order.
task: Check the dependencies and propose a safe upgrade plan.
